categories.question: You sit down beside a flowering shrub. Which butterfly would you most like to land nearby?

outcomes.name: A monarch on milkweed
outcomes.description: Orange-and-black monarch butterfly perched on a pink milkweed flower cluster

outcomes.name: A swallowtail on fennel
outcomes.description: Yellow-and-black swallowtail with distinct hindwing tails opening over fennel

outcomes.name: A blue morpho on a leaf
outcomes.description: Brilliant iridescent blue morpho butterfly resting with wings open on a broad leaf

outcomes.name: A painted lady on lavender
outcomes.description: Orange-and-black painted lady resting on one purple lavender sprig
